voices.name: StandWithUs
voices.intro: StandWithUs is an international education organization founded in 2001 and based in Los Angeles. It produces campus programs, explainers and videos that present the case for Israel and answer common claims.

voices.name: IDF Spokesperson
voices.intro: The IDF Spokesperson's Unit is the official media and public information arm of the Israel Defense Forces. It publishes the IDF's statements, videos and updates in several languages.

voices.name: HonestReporting
voices.intro: HonestReporting is a media watchdog founded in Jerusalem in 2000. It reviews coverage of Israel and the Middle East, publishes corrections and analysis, and explains how stories are framed.

voices.name: CAMERA
voices.intro: CAMERA, the Committee for Accuracy in Middle East Reporting in America, was founded in 1982 in Boston. It monitors news coverage and publishes fact checks, articles and short videos.
voices.wiki: Committee for Accuracy in Middle East Reporting in America

voices.name: Foundation for Defense of Democracies
voices.intro: The Foundation for Defense of Democracies is a Washington research institute focused on national security and foreign policy. Its analysts write often on Iran, terrorism financing and the security of Israel.

voices.name: American Jewish Committee
voices.intro: The American Jewish Committee was founded in 1906 and is one of the oldest Jewish advocacy organizations. It publishes policy analysis and hosts the People of the Pod podcast on Israel and Jewish life.

voices.name: Anti-Defamation League
voices.intro: The Anti-Defamation League was founded in 1913 to fight antisemitism. It publishes research on hate and extremism, including material on antisemitism connected to debate about Israel.

voices.name: JINSA
voices.intro: The Jewish Institute for National Security of America is a Washington policy organization founded in 1976. It publishes analysis on defense cooperation between the United States and Israel.
voices.wiki: Jewish Institute for National Security of America

voices.name: Christians United for Israel
voices.intro: Christians United for Israel was founded in 2006 and is the largest Christian pro-Israel organization in the United States. It publishes news, advocacy updates and teaching videos.

voices.name: Tikvah Fund
voices.intro: The Tikvah Fund supports Jewish and Israeli thought through courses, fellowships and publications. Its podcasts and the magazine Mosaic bring scholars and writers into the discussion of Israel.

voices.name: MEMRI
voices.intro: The Middle East Media Research Institute was founded in 1998 in Washington. It translates Arabic, Persian and Turkish media into English, and its video clips show what leaders and broadcasters say to their own audiences. Clips are embedded here with MEMRI credited.

voices.name: JNS
voices.intro: JNS, the Jewish News Syndicate, supplies news, opinion and video on Israel and Jewish communities worldwide. It also produces a range of shows and podcasts, which are gathered on this page.

voices.name: Eylon Levy
voices.intro: Eylon Levy is a British-Israeli journalist and broadcaster who served as an international spokesman for the Israeli government. He now speaks and writes on his own channels.
voices.tags: former Israeli government spokesperson, EylON the Record, interviews

voices.name: Ben Shapiro
voices.intro: Ben Shapiro is an American commentator and co-founder of The Daily Wire. His daily show and writing return often to Israel, the Middle East and antisemitism.

voices.name: Douglas Murray
voices.intro: Douglas Murray is a British author and commentator. His books and interviews on the war in Gaza and on Western attitudes toward Israel have reached a wide audience.
voices.tags: Western opinion, cultural debate, long-form interviews

voices.name: Bari Weiss
voices.intro: Bari Weiss is Editor-in-Chief of CBS News and the co-founder of The Free Press, the independent media company she built after leaving The New York Times. Her essays, reporting and podcasts frequently take up Israel, antisemitism and free speech.
voices.tags: Editor-in-Chief, CBS News · Co-founder, The Free Press

voices.name: Noa Tishby
voices.intro: Noa Tishby is an Israeli-American actress, producer and author of a popular book on Israel. She served as Israel's special envoy for combating antisemitism and delegitimization.
voices.tags: public diplomacy, cultural media, guest interviews

voices.name: Yishai Fleisher
voices.intro: Yishai Fleisher is an international spokesman for the Jewish community of Hebron and host of a long-running Israel-focused podcast and video show.

voices.name: Hen Mazzig
voices.intro: Hen Mazzig is an Israeli writer and speaker, a former IDF officer and the author of a memoir about growing up in Israel. He speaks on Israel, Jewish identity and the Middle East.

voices.name: Dan Senor
voices.intro: Dan Senor is a policy adviser and author of Start-Up Nation. He hosts the Call Me Back podcast, a daily conversation about Israel and the news.

voices.name: Rudy Rochman
voices.intro: Rudy Rochman is a Jewish activist and former IDF soldier who speaks on campuses and online about Israel, Jewish history and antisemitism.

voices.name: Emily Schrader
voices.intro: Emily Schrader is an Israeli-American media commentator and creator of videos and interviews on Israel, the region and Israeli society.

voices.name: The Israel Guys
voices.intro: The Israel Guys is an independent video channel that reports and comments on Israel and the Middle East.

voices.name: Einat Wilf
voices.intro: Einat Wilf is an Israeli author and former member of the Knesset. She writes and speaks on Zionism and Palestinian nationalism, hosts the podcast We Should All Be Zionists, and is co-author of The War of Return.
voices.tags: Zionism, Palestinian nationalism, podcast host, We Should All Be Zionists

voices.name: Haviv Rettig Gur
voices.intro: Haviv Rettig Gur is an Israeli journalist and senior analyst at The Times of Israel. He is known for long explanatory talks and interviews on Israeli politics, history and the war.
voices.tags: Israeli history, strategy, podcast host, Ask Haviv Anything

voices.name: Mosab Hassan Yousef
voices.intro: Mosab Hassan Yousef is a Palestinian author and the son of a founder of Hamas. He later worked with Israeli security services and wrote the memoir Son of Hamas, and he speaks about Hamas and its ideas.

voices.name: Natasha Hausdorff
voices.intro: Natasha Hausdorff is a British barrister who specialises in international law. She speaks and writes often on the International Court of Justice, the International Criminal Court and the legal debates around the war.
voices.tags: international law, ICJ, ICC, legal debates

voices.name: Jonathan Conricus
voices.intro: Jonathan Conricus is a former international spokesperson of the Israel Defense Forces and a senior fellow at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies. He is a frequent guest on television and podcasts.

voices.name: Daniel Hagari
voices.intro: Daniel Hagari is a former chief spokesperson of the Israel Defense Forces. His briefings and interviews during the war were widely carried by international media.

voices.name: Effie Defrin
voices.intro: Effie Defrin is the IDF spokesperson from 2025. His official briefings set out the army's account of operations. Roles in the army change, so check the current title.

voices.name: Nadav Shoshani
voices.intro: Nadav Shoshani is an international spokesperson of the Israel Defense Forces and a regular voice in English-language press interviews.
voices.tags: IDF international spokesperson, English press interviews

voices.name: Peter Lerner
voices.intro: Peter Lerner is a former international spokesperson of the Israel Defense Forces. He speaks on military operations and media analysis.

voices.name: Richard Hecht
voices.intro: Richard Hecht is a former international spokesperson of the Israel Defense Forces, known for news interviews and briefings.

voices.name: Doron Spielman
voices.intro: Doron Spielman is a former spokesperson of the Israel Defense Forces who speaks on public diplomacy and Israeli history.
voices.tags: former IDF spokesperson, public diplomacy, history

voices.name: Dan Schueftan
voices.intro: Dan Schueftan is an Israeli scholar of security and Arab politics. He is a frequent guest on podcasts that discuss Israel's strategic position.
voices.tags: Israeli security, Arab politics, podcast guest

voices.name: Hillel Fuld
voices.intro: Hillel Fuld is an Israel-based technology adviser and digital advocate who speaks about Israel's tech sector and online advocacy.

voices.name: Shai Davidai
voices.intro: Shai Davidai is a professor at Columbia Business School who speaks out on antisemitism on campus and in academia.

voices.name: Caroline Glick
voices.intro: Caroline Glick is an Israeli-American columnist and commentator on Israeli strategy and relations between the United States and Israel.

voices.name: Michael Oren
voices.intro: Michael Oren is a historian and former Israeli ambassador to the United States and member of the Knesset. He is the author of Six Days of War.

voices.name: John Spencer
voices.intro: John Spencer is an American military analyst and urban warfare expert who explains the conduct of the fighting in Gaza and other cities.
voices.tags: urban warfare, military operations, military analysis

voices.name: Melanie Phillips
voices.intro: Melanie Phillips is a British journalist and author who writes on Israel, antisemitism and Western politics.

voices.name: Yossi Klein Halevi
voices.intro: Yossi Klein Halevi is an Israeli-American author and senior fellow at the Shalom Hartman Institute. He writes on Jewish identity and Israeli society.
voices.tags: Jewish identity, Israeli society, podcast interviews

voices.name: Bret Stephens
voices.intro: Bret Stephens is an American columnist at The New York Times who writes on Israel, Judaism and world affairs.

voices.name: Elliot Kaufman
voices.intro: Elliot Kaufman is an American journalist who writes on Israeli affairs and US politics for The Wall Street Journal.
voices.tags: US journalism, Israeli affairs, podcast interviews

voices.name: Hussein Aboubakr Mansour
voices.intro: Hussein Aboubakr Mansour is an Egyptian-born author and speaker who writes on Arab and Islamic discourse and on antisemitism.

voices.name: Khaled Abu Toameh
voices.intro: Khaled Abu Toameh is a Palestinian-Israeli journalist who has reported for decades on Palestinian politics and society.

voices.name: Miriam H. Elman
voices.intro: Miriam H. Elman is a political science professor at Syracuse University and executive director of the Academic Engagement Network. She speaks on campus politics and antisemitism.

voices.name: Richard Kemp
voices.intro: Richard Kemp is a retired British Army colonel and former commander of British forces in Afghanistan. He speaks on the laws and realities of modern warfare.
